observations: account read: inv-1.owed-test.nhk.near; balances are the raw mt_balance_of on intents.near (public view), not a formatted dollar value

minutes = block time of the last nearTxHash (the public transfer intent, from NearBlocks v3) minus the origin-chain block time; the status updatedAt is a heartbeat and is NOT used (it was 27 minutes after the credit)
each swap shows two NEAR txs: ft_deposit to intents.near (bridged credit to the deposit-address account), then execute_intents with a public transfer intent to the invoice account

the Intents credit landed on a NEAR account that did not exist; recovery needs the account to exist and be controllable by the parent (design impact: issue(n) must run before recovery, ideally before the payer sees the deposit address)
the original part B report records only transactions_broadcast; this report supersedes it for the PASS decision
